summary: Meta's Muse has topped 6.6 million downloads since its Sept. 8 launch and reached 1.8 million daily active users, as consumers show they're ready to hand over their personal information for a chance at some AI assistance. Seema Shah, VP: Insights at Sensor Tower, discusses the growth of personal AI
